name: Hammer Championship Title
caption: Hammer Wrestling's top singles title, vacant throughout the surviving run while an eight-man tournament to crown a champion began.
epitaph: Hammer Wrestling's top singles title, vacant from its introduction in 2001. An eight-man tournament to crown its first champion began, and no champion is named in any of the promotion's own posts.

name: Hammer Tag Team Championship
caption: Hammer Wrestling's tag team title, vacant throughout the surviving run.
epitaph: Hammer Wrestling's tag team title, introduced in 2001 and vacant in every one of the promotion's own posts; no team is ever named its champions.
